entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer service. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to return a pair of cycling shoes and some tires I recently purchased.
Okay, I can help you with that. Could you provide me with your order number, please?
Thank you. I see the order here. Before we proceed, could you confirm if the shoes or tires have been mounted or used in any way?
Well, yeah. I did try them out. I had the tires installed on my bike, and I rode with the shoes a couple of times. There are definitely cleat marks on the shoes.

I understand. Unfortunately, because the tires were installed and the shoes show cleat marks indicating they've been used, we cannot accept them for return. Once tires are installed, even briefly, and especially with dirty tires from riding, they are no longer considered new. Similarly, shoes with cleat marks fall into the used category. We cannot resell these items as new, which is our standard return policy requirement.
Oh, I see. I didn't realize that. So, there's nothing you can do?
I'm afraid that's correct. Items must be in new, unused condition to be eligible for a return. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
Okay, I understand. Thanks for clarifying.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks again for your help.
You're very welcome. Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit!
